newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas says there will be more exceptionals.
newsitem.headline: Havas says there will be more exceptionals.

text.p: French group Havas, which on Thursday announced higher first-half profits partly due to sales of media holdings, said on Friday there will be other exceptional items which will influence results in the second half and the first half of 1997.
"In the second half, there will be other exceptional items as well as at the start of 1997," finance director Nicolas Duhamel told a briefing.
He said there would be an exceptional profit following the CLT/UFA merger for which Bertelsmann is to pay five billion francs to Luxembourg-based CLT, in which Havas has about 10 percent.
